name: i2v.ai MCP Server
description: Generate images and videos across 12 image models and 16 video models from one hosted MCP server, quoting each paid task in USD and honouring a caller-set spending ceiling before it runs.
examples: Hosted endpoint: https://i2v.ai/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE or a Bearer API key)
list_models -> estimate_cost -> create_task with maxCostUsd -> get_task

requirements.other: I2V_API_KEY for the local stdio server, or an OAuth sign-in for the hosted endpoint

features: 12 image models and 16 video models behind one interface
USD quote returned before every paid task
Caller-set maxCostUsd ceiling rejects over-budget reservations
13 tools, 3 prompt templates and 12 client guides over MCP
Text-to-video and image-to-video in the same endpoint
